as_told.title: Bradshaw Ranch transmedium UFOs and armed guards

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an investigative journalist, Ross Coulthart, has been researching Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona. According to Michels, there is a place there called Secret Mountain where UFOs are said to fly into the mountain itself. If true, it would suggest these craft have hidden bases inside the earth.
